sentences.text: Es lunes, y Sam no se levanta.
sentences.english: It is Monday, and Sam does not get up.

sentences.text: Karla entra en el dormitorio y no oye nada.
sentences.english: Karla goes into the bedroom and hears nothing.

sentences.text: Entra con cuidado en la habitación.
sentences.english: She goes carefully into the room.

sentences.text: Sam está en la cama, con la cara roja y los ojos pequeños.
sentences.english: Sam is in bed, with his face red and his eyes small.

sentences.text: Sam, ¿qué te pasa?
sentences.english: Sam, what's wrong?
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Tenés las mejillas rojas y el cabello en la cara.
sentences.english: Your cheeks are red and your hair is on your face.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Me duele la cabeza, y también las piernas.
sentences.english: My head hurts, and my legs too.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Tengo mucha sed, y los labios me duelen.
sentences.english: I'm very thirsty, and my lips hurt.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Dejame ver.
sentences.english: Let me see.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Tenés la cara muy caliente.
sentences.english: Your face is very hot.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Si tenés fiebre, hay que llamar a Ana.
sentences.english: If you have a fever, we have to call Ana.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Estoy débil.
sentences.english: I'm weak.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Casi no puedo levantar la mano.
sentences.english: I can hardly lift my hand.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Un vaso de agua está pesado como una olla.
sentences.english: A glass of water is heavy like a pot.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: No te movás.
sentences.english: Don't move.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Voy a traerte agua.
sentences.english: I'll bring you water.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Si tenés sed, tomá agua fresca.
sentences.english: If you're thirsty, drink cool water.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: No la tomés muy fría ni muy caliente.
sentences.english: Don't drink it too cold or too hot.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Mejor tibia.
sentences.english: Better lukewarm.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: ¿Y si el agua me cae mal?
sentences.english: And if the water doesn't agree with me?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Si te cae mal, lo intentamos otra vez con menos.
sentences.english: If it doesn't agree with you, we'll try again with less.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Primero tengo que llamar a Ana.
sentences.english: First I have to call Ana.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Karla hace una llamada.
sentences.english: Karla makes a call.

sentences.text: Habla poco, pero con paz.
sentences.english: She speaks little, but calmly.

sentences.text: Después regresa con una jarra llena de agua y un vaso vacío.
sentences.english: Then she comes back with a jug full of water and an empty glass.

sentences.text: Llena el vaso hasta la mitad.
sentences.english: She fills the glass halfway.

sentences.text: Esa tarde, Luis maneja hasta la casa de Karla con Ana.
sentences.english: That afternoon Luis drives to Karla's house with Ana.

sentences.text: Estaciona el carro en la esquina, porque la calle es pequeña.
sentences.english: He parks the car on the corner, because the street is small.

sentences.text: Ana cruza el patio con su bolsa.
sentences.english: Ana crosses the courtyard with her bag.

sentences.text: Buenas tardes, Karla.
sentences.english: Good afternoon, Karla.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: ¿Dónde está el enfermo?
sentences.english: Where is the patient?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: En su habitación.
sentences.english: In his room.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Tiene fiebre desde la mañana, y está muy débil.
sentences.english: He's had a fever since the morning, and he is very weak.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Ana entra y mira a Sam.
sentences.english: Ana goes in and looks at Sam.

sentences.text: Pone la mano en su mejilla y en sus manos.
sentences.english: She puts her hand on his cheek and his hands.

sentences.text: Le mira los ojos, los labios y el aliento.
sentences.english: She looks at his eyes, his lips and his breath.

sentences.text: Le pide que abra la boca.
sentences.english: She asks him to open his mouth.

sentences.text: Sam, ¿qué sentís?
sentences.english: Sam, what do you feel?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: ¿Te duele el cuerpo?
sentences.english: Does your body hurt?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: ¿Te duele la pierna?
sentences.english: Does your leg hurt?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Me duele todo.
sentences.english: Everything hurts.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Tengo sed todo el tiempo.
sentences.english: I'm thirsty all the time.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Y también me duele la vista.
sentences.english: And my sight hurts too.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Eso pasa con la fiebre.
sentences.english: That happens with a fever.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Podría ser dengue, o podría ser otra cosa.
sentences.english: It could be dengue, or it could be something else.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Tenemos que hacer una prueba.
sentences.english: We have to do a test.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: ¿Es peligroso?
sentences.english: Is it dangerous?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Puede ser peligroso si no lo cuidás.
sentences.english: It can be dangerous if you don't take care of it.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Pero si tomás agua, descansás y vas al hospital cuando te lo digo, no hay que temer.
sentences.english: But if you drink water, rest and go to the hospital when I tell you, there is no need to fear.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Es importante no temer, pero tampoco hay que olvidar el cuidado.
sentences.english: It is important not to fear, but we must also not forget to be careful.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Ana se sienta al lado de la cama y explica a Sam y a Karla lo que tienen que hacer.
sentences.english: Ana sits beside the bed and explains to Sam and Karla what they have to do.

sentences.text: Primero, el agua.
sentences.english: First, water.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si tenés fiebre, bebé mucha agua.
sentences.english: If you have a fever, drink a lot of water.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si tenés sed, no esperés: bebé ahora.
sentences.english: If you're thirsty, don't wait: drink now.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Es necesario tener el cuerpo lleno de agua.
sentences.english: It is necessary to have your body full of water.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si el vaso está vacío, llenalo; si está lleno, bebé.
sentences.english: If the glass is empty, fill it; if it is full, drink.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Después, la comida.
sentences.english: Then, food.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si no tenés hambre, comé algo ligero: sopa, arroz blando, pan suave.
sentences.english: If you're not hungry, eat something light: soup, soft rice, soft bread.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si comés cosas pesadas, te vas a sentir mal.
sentences.english: If you eat heavy things, you'll feel bad.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: ¿Y el pan duro?
sentences.english: And hard bread?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Si el pan está duro, mejor no lo comás.
sentences.english: If the bread is hard, better not to eat it.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Hay que buscar lo blando.
sentences.english: You have to look for what is soft.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si podés, comé un poco cada hora.
sentences.english: If you can, eat a little every hour.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Y si el aliento te huele mal, tomá más agua.
sentences.english: And if your breath smells bad, drink more water.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Luego, la habitación.
sentences.english: Then, the room.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Mantené la habitación fresca.
sentences.english: Keep the room cool.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si hace calor, abrí la cortina y movela.
sentences.english: If it is hot, open the curtain and move it.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si hay mucha luz, apagá la luz.
sentences.english: If there is too much light, turn off the light.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Colocá una manta ligera, no pesada.
sentences.english: Put on a light blanket, not a heavy one.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si tenés frío, cubrite un poco, pero no mucho.
sentences.english: If you're cold, cover up a bit, but not much.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Y si te duele la pierna, no andés mucho.
sentences.english: And if your leg hurts, don't walk much.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: ¿Y si le sube la fiebre?
sentences.english: And if his fever goes up?
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Si le sube la fiebre, o si habla mal, o si el aliento le huele diferente, me llamás.
sentences.english: If his fever goes up, or if he speaks badly, or if his breath smells different, you call me.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Y si hay sangre, vamos al hospital ahora.
sentences.english: And if there is blood, we go to the hospital now.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Karla, si Sam duerme mucho, está bien.
sentences.english: Karla, if Sam sleeps a lot, that's fine.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si no puede despertar, es peligroso.
sentences.english: If he can't wake up, it's dangerous.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Deberías mirarlo cada hora.
sentences.english: You should look at him every hour.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Al otro día, la fiebre no baja.
sentences.english: The next day the fever does not go down.

sentences.text: Luis conduce hasta el hospital, y Ana va con ellos.
sentences.english: Luis drives to the hospital, and Ana goes with them.

sentences.text: En la avenida hay mucha gente.
sentences.english: On the avenue there are lots of people.

sentences.text: Un carro grande impide el camino, y Luis tiene que detenerse en la esquina.
sentences.english: A big vehicle blocks the way, and Luis has to stop at the corner.

sentences.text: Hoy hay un anuncio en la avenida.
sentences.english: Today there is a notice on the avenue.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: No se permite estacionar cerca del hospital.
sentences.english: Parking near the hospital is not permitted.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Entonces dejamos el carro en el restaurante de la esquina.
sentences.english: Then we leave the car at the restaurant on the corner.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Allá sí se puede estacionar.
sentences.english: There you can park.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: El hospital es público, pero hay una parte privada también.
sentences.english: The hospital is public, but there is a private part too.

sentences.text: En la parte pública hay mucha gente esperando.
sentences.english: In the public part there are lots of people waiting.

sentences.text: Ana conoce a una enfermera, y ella ayuda a Sam.
sentences.english: Ana knows a nurse, and she helps Sam.

sentences.text: Aquí no me obligan a esperar mucho, ¿verdad?
sentences.english: They don't make me wait long here, do they?
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: No es para vos, Luis.
sentences.english: It's not for you, Luis.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Es para Sam.
sentences.english: It's for Sam.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Sam, presentá tu pasaporte y firmá aquí.
sentences.english: Sam, show your passport and sign here.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: ¿Tengo que firmar algo?
sentences.english: Do I have to sign something?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Sí.
sentences.english: Yes.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Es una forma, y es necesaria.
sentences.english: It is a form, and it is necessary.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Karla, vos también firmá.
sentences.english: Karla, you sign too.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: La prueba sale bien: no es dengue.
sentences.english: The test comes out fine: it is not dengue.

sentences.text: El doctor dice que Sam solo necesita agua y tiempo, y que debe descansar.
sentences.english: The doctor says Sam only needs water and time, and that he must rest.

sentences.text: Dos días después, Sam está mejor.
sentences.english: Two days later Sam is better.

sentences.text: Ana lo invita a la clínica, porque tiene una reunión para madres con bebés.
sentences.english: Ana invites him to the clinic, because she has a meeting for mothers with babies.

sentences.text: Sam quiere ayudar, pero se sienta en la sala y escucha.
sentences.english: Sam wants to help, but he sits in the waiting room and listens.

sentences.text: Buenas tardes, señoras.
sentences.english: Good afternoon, ladies.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Hoy vamos a hablar de los bebés.
sentences.english: Today we are going to talk about babies.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si su bebé tiene fiebre, actúen con paz.
sentences.english: If your baby has a fever, act calmly.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Primero revisen el peso y la temperatura.
sentences.english: First check the weight and the temperature.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si el bebé está débil y no quiere comer, vengan a la clínica.
sentences.english: If the baby is weak and doesn't want to eat, come to the clinic.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si tiene la mejilla muy caliente, mantengan el cuerpo fresco.
sentences.english: If the cheek is very hot, keep the body cool.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Pueden usar agua tibia, no muy fría.
sentences.english: You can use lukewarm water, not too cold.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Doctora, ¿y si el bebé tiene un golpe en la cabeza?
sentences.english: Doctor, and what if the baby has a bump on the head?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Si el golpe es grande, o si el bebé llora mucho, o si no mira bien, vengan ahora.
sentences.english: If the bump is big, or if the baby cries a lot, or if he doesn't look right, come now.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Su vista es muy importante.
sentences.english: His sight is very important.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Es peligroso esperar.
sentences.english: It is dangerous to wait.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Y los cortes, doña Ana.
sentences.english: And cuts, doña Ana.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Mi niño siempre se hace cortes en las manos.
sentences.english: My boy is always cutting his hands.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Si hay un corte, ponga agua limpia en la herida.
sentences.english: If there is a cut, put clean water on the wound.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: La limpieza es lo más útil.
sentences.english: Cleanliness is the most useful thing.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si la herida no mejora, vengan a la clínica.
sentences.english: If the wound doesn't get better, come to the clinic.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Una cosa más.
sentences.english: One more thing.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Después del agua, cubran al bebé con una toalla suave y mantengan su cabello limpio.
sentences.english: After the water, cover the baby with a soft towel and keep his hair clean.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Ana también habla en una reunión general de la comunidad.
sentences.english: Ana also speaks at a general meeting of the community.

sentences.text: La clínica anuncia una oferta: esta semana la prueba cuesta menos.
sentences.english: The clinic announces an offer: this week the test costs less.

sentences.text: Hay mucha gente, y todos escuchan con cuidado.
sentences.english: There are lots of people, and everyone listens carefully.

sentences.text: Si quieren estar sanos, necesitan tres cosas: limpieza, agua y tiempo para descansar.
sentences.english: If you want to be healthy, you need three things: cleanliness, water and time to rest.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si no hay una, el cuerpo se pone débil.
sentences.english: If there is not one, the body gets weak.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Primero, la limpieza.
sentences.english: First, cleanliness.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si tienen un bebé, cuiden su cabello y su piel.
sentences.english: If you have a baby, look after his hair and skin.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: La limpieza es útil para todo.
sentences.english: Cleanliness is useful for everything.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: No tiren basura en la calle.
sentences.english: Don't throw rubbish in the street.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si el bebé está sano, su peso sube cada mes.
sentences.english: If the baby is healthy, his weight goes up every month.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si su peso no sube, vengan a la clínica.
sentences.english: If his weight doesn't go up, come to the clinic.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Ese peso es una señal importante.
sentences.english: That weight is an important sign.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si un niño tiene un golpe en la pierna, no lo obliguen a andar.
sentences.english: If a child has a bump on the leg, don't make him walk.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si la comida huele mal, no la coman.
sentences.english: If the food smells bad, don't eat it.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Los niños no deben llevar cosas pesadas.
sentences.english: Children should not carry heavy things.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Cuando hay fiebre, una comida ligera es útil.
sentences.english: When there is a fever, a light meal is useful.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si el pan está duro, es mejor un pan blando.
sentences.english: If the bread is hard, a soft bread is better.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si la jarra está vacía, llénenla.
sentences.english: If the jug is empty, fill it.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Si el agua está tibia, es mejor para los labios.
sentences.english: If the water is lukewarm, it is better for the lips.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Para ver bien, la vista necesita luz.
sentences.english: To see well, sight needs light.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Enciendan la luz de la sala, y si el niño tiene fiebre, hay que parar el juego.
sentences.english: Turn on the living-room light, and if the child has a fever, you have to stop the game.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Es necesario también informar a la clínica.
sentences.english: It is also necessary to inform the clinic.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: En esta estación, la lluvia aumenta los insectos.
sentences.english: In this season, the rain increases the insects.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Informen de toda fiebre.
sentences.english: Report every fever.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: No hay que temer.
sentences.english: There is no need to fear.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Solo hay que actuar.
sentences.english: We only need to act.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: En casa, Karla trabaja mientras Sam descansa.
sentences.english: At home Karla works while Sam rests.

sentences.text: Ordena la sala, mueve el sofá y barre el piso.
sentences.english: She tidies the living room, moves the sofa and sweeps the floor.

sentences.text: Saca la almohada vieja del armario y mete una almohada suave.
sentences.english: She takes the old pillow out of the wardrobe and puts a soft pillow in.

sentences.text: Guarda las tazas en el comedor y quita la basura.
sentences.english: She puts the cups away in the dining room and takes out the rubbish.

sentences.text: Sam, en este hogar nadie está enfermo mucho tiempo.
sentences.english: Sam, in this home nobody is sick for long.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Si te quedás en cama y bebés agua, vas a estar sano pronto.
sentences.english: If you stay in bed and drink water, you will be healthy soon.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Gracias, Karla.
sentences.english: Thanks, Karla.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Sos muy buena conmigo.
sentences.english: You are very good to me.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Callate y descansá.
sentences.english: Be quiet and rest.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Agarrá el vaso, tomá un poco de agua y no hables.
sentences.english: Take the glass, drink some water and don't speak.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Está bien.
sentences.english: All right.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Pero antes dejame decir una cosa: la sopa de doña Marta me hizo mucho bien.
sentences.english: But first let me say one thing: doña Marta's soup did me a lot of good.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Ya lo sé.
sentences.english: I know.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Y si querés más, te preparo otra.
sentences.english: And if you want more, I'll make you another.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Ahora, si te sentís mal, me llamás.
sentences.english: Now, if you feel bad, call me.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Los dos platican un poco.
sentences.english: The two chat for a while.

sentences.text: Karla ríe, y Sam tiene una sonrisa.
sentences.english: Karla laughs, and Sam has a smile.

sentences.text: Esa risa hace bien al cuerpo.
sentences.english: That laughter does the body good.

sentences.text: En esos días de fiebre, Sam aprende algo importante: cuando uno está débil, necesita a las otras personas.
sentences.english: In those days of fever, Sam learns something important: when you are weak, you need other people.

sentences.text: Esa noche, Karla va al supermercado.
sentences.english: That night Karla goes to the supermarket.

sentences.text: Allá hay una farmacia que anuncia una venta de pastillas.
sentences.english: There is a pharmacy there that announces a sale on pills.

sentences.text: Karla presenta su tarjeta, y firman los dos.
sentences.english: Karla presents her card, and the two of them sign.

sentences.text: Ella revisa el precio.
sentences.english: She checks the price.

sentences.text: La compra incluye las pastillas que Ana indicó.
sentences.english: The purchase includes the pills that Ana indicated.

sentences.text: Ojalá que no las necesités por mucho tiempo.
sentences.english: I hope you don't need them for long.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Ojalá.
sentences.english: I hope so.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: En la vuelta a casa, quiero comer algo caliente.
sentences.english: On the way back home, I want to eat something warm.
sentences.speaker: S
